# hubspot_contact_segment (Resource)

Manages one HubSpot Contact segment definition by generated ILS list `id`. Contact memberships are not managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hubspot_contact_segment" "active_customers" {
  name            = "Active customers"
  processing_type = "dynamic"

  filter_groups = [{
    filters = [{
      property      = "ns_onboarding_status"
      operator      = "is_equal_to"
      property_kind = "select"
      value         = "active"
    }]
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Nonblank mutable Contact segment name. HubSpot enforces remote uniqueness; the provider never searches or adopts by name.
- `processing_type` (String) Processing type: `manual`, `dynamic`, or `snapshot`. Changes replace the definition.

### Optional

- `filter_groups` (Attributes Set) Unordered OR branches, each containing an unordered AND set of Contact property filters. Required for `dynamic` and `snapshot`; forbidden for `manual`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter_groups))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical positive-decimal ILS list `id` and sole state and import identity.

<a id="nestedatt--filter_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter_groups`

Required:

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Unordered AND predicates in this OR branch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter_groups--filters))

<a id="nestedatt--filter_groups--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter_groups.filters`

Required:

- `operator` (String) Supported equality or presence operator.
- `property` (String) Exact internal Contact property name.

Optional:

- `property_kind` (String) Declared property kind, `text` or `select`, required for equality operators and forbidden for presence operators.
- `value` (String) One nonblank equality value; forbidden for presence operators.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hubspot_contact_segment.active_customers 123456789
```
